description:
## Features

### YouTube - Built-in downloader
- **Download whole playlists:** the offline library has a new `Download playlist` button. Paste a playlist link or id (a copied playlist link is filled in), then pick a maximum quality: Best available, 1080p, 720p, 480p or 360p. YouTube's own playlist download button and `Download playlist` menu entry also start it where YouTube shows them (YouTube shows them only to some accounts).
- **Quality per video:** each video gets the best quality up to your limit, resolved when its turn comes, so long playlists do not outlive their stream links.
- **Skips what you have:** videos already downloaded or already queued are skipped. Run the download again after a failure and only the missing videos are retried.
- **One summary:** a playlist shows one notification at its end ("N downloaded · M failed · K cancelled") instead of one per video. The progress notification shows the place in the playlist and has a `Cancel all` action, and the offline library has a `Cancel all` button.
- The queue is kept in memory, so closing the app ends it.

## Compatibility
- YouTube: **21.39.525, 21.13.164, 20.05.46**.
- YouTube Music: **9.40.51, 9.15.51, 8.30.54**.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/lavinhoque33/revanced-patches/compare/v1.10.4...v1.11.0)
